description: The chart illustrates measured “Popularity” values for three topical categories (Movies, Songs, Basketball) shown separately for three AI models (Llama3, Qwen2, ChatGPT) and three accuracy/answer conditions indicated by fill patterns. The horizontal axis contains the categories Movies, Songs, and Basketball in that left-to-right order, and the vertical axis is labeled “Popularity” on a linear scale with labeled ticks at 20, 60, 100, 140, 180, and 220 (range 20–220). Within each category, bars are grouped by model color—Llama3 in blue, Qwen2 in red, and ChatGPT in yellow—and for each model there are three adjacent bars corresponding to the legend patterns: “Acc=0 & GT Ans” (crosshatched/mesh), “Acc=0 & Gene Ans” (diagonal stripes), and “Acc=1 & GT Ans” (solid fill). For Movies, Llama3 shows approximately 25 (mesh), 35 (diagonal), and 40 (solid); Qwen2 shows about 28 (mesh), 40 (diagonal), and 45 (solid); and ChatGPT shows about 26 (mesh), 30 (diagonal), and 35 (solid). For Songs, Llama3 shows about 58 (mesh), 50 (diagonal), and 72 (solid); Qwen2 shows about 55 (mesh), 65 (diagonal), and 85 (solid); and ChatGPT shows about 48 (mesh), 55 (diagonal), and 75 (solid). For Basketball, Llama3 shows about 100 (mesh), 155 (diagonal), and 178 (solid); Qwen2 shows about 100 (mesh), 188 (diagonal), and 210 (solid); and ChatGPT shows about 98 (mesh), 170 (diagonal), and 138 (solid). The bars are not presented as a single sorted series; instead they are arranged by category with consistent within-category grouping by model and condition, and no bars appear specially emphasized beyond the color and pattern encodings described in the legend.
caption_used: The bar chart depicts the popularity of three categories—Movies, Songs, and Basketball—across three AI models (Llama3, Qwen2, and ChatGPT) under varying accuracy conditions. The horizontal axis lists the categories, while the vertical axis quantifies popularity on a scale from 20 to 220. Bars are segmented into three conditions: 'Acc=0 & GT Ans' (mesh pattern), 'Acc=0 & Gene Ans' (diagonal stripes), and 'Acc=1 & GT Ans' (solid color). For Movies, popularity values hover around 30 to 40, with Qwen2 exhibiting the lowest total bar height. In Songs, popularity ranges from approximately 60 to 90, where Llama3 consistently surpasses the other models. Notably, in Basketball, popularity peaks dramatically, with Qwen2 reaching a value of 210, while ChatGPT lags significantly behind at roughly 120. The data reveal that Qwen2 generally dominates in popularity across all categories, particularly in Basketball, whereas ChatGPT underperforms relative to its counterparts in both Songs and Basketball.
